# evenfire — documentation index for LLMs

> Curated map of public docs. Prefer these paths over random monorepo files.
> Code/API still use the historical name "clerum" (clerum.io, CLERUM_*).
> Docs describe what deploy/base and the minikube overlays ship; off-by-default features say so. design/ records are point-in-time, not maintained.

## Start here

- README: ../README.md — product pitch, security model, providers, license
- Quickstart: get-started/quickstart.md — full platform on minikube: fill in .env, then one command
- Registry quickstart: get-started/registry-quickstart.md — self-hosted connect → install → publish round trip
- Dev mode (mcp-host without Kubernetes): get-started/dev-mode.md
- Learning path: get-started/learning-path.md
- FAQ: faq.md
